messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's current action with the action demonstrated in the motion reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Use the reference video only for the action. Keep the person's identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still in profile, then turns his body to face away from the camera and back again while raising his hand to his neck.","camera":"A static, medium full shot at eye level that keeps the subject centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white ribbed long-sleeve shirt with a high collar, brown suspenders, brown plaid trousers, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"White or platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair with a side part.","identity":"A young man with a slim build and dark skin, shown in profile and then from behind.","scene":"An outdoor paved road or parking area with a metal guardrail, green trees, and large rocks in the background under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original arm-raising/turning motion was replaced with a slower sequence: the person stands in profile, turns away from the camera, brings a hand toward the neck/shoulder, turns back toward the camera, and returns to a standing profile pose. The subject's clothing, hair, body type, outdoor road scene, and static camera framing remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's current action with the motion shown in the reference, while preserving identity, appearance, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: The exact match to the reference motion is approximate; the output captures the general turning and hand-to-neck gesture but not every detailed pose from the reference.
unexpected_changes: The output frames show black letterbox bars on the left and right edges, which were not visible in the source frames.
